title: Onramp: Optimizer onboarding asset set — batching, caching & quant UI
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Design and deliver a compact, scannable onramp asset set for the Optimize toolkit that teaches engineers how batching, prefix/KV caching, and quantization tradeoffs affect latency and cost. Assets include hero art, a 5-screen microflow for the onboarding modal, three micro-interaction GIFs, three annotated product screenshots for the Console, and copy for tooltips and help docs.
goals: Reduce time-to-first-optimization for new users by providing actionable recommendations in the Console and docs
Surface tradeoffs (latency vs cost vs quality) in a developer-friendly way
Create reusable visual assets that engineering and content teams can embed in docs, release notes, and the onboarding modal
assets_needed: Hero illustration: single-scene metaphor (data pipeline + gears) — SVG + PNG @2x
5-screen microflow (Figma) for onboarding modal: Welcome -> Workload profile picker -> Batch & Cache recommendations -> Quantization suggestions -> Quickstart CTA
3 micro-interaction GIFs: batch-size slider, cache-lookup animation, quant toggle preview
3 annotated Console screenshots (desktop): Route details, Model config panel, Rollout test preview
Copy bundle: short lines for tooltip, medium paragraphs for docs, one-liner for release notes
Accessibility assets: high-contrast hero, alt-text and descriptive transcripts for GIFs
Exported assets: PNG, SVG, WEBM for animations, and single-page PDF design spec
screen_flow: Screen 1: Onramp welcome — headline, 3 quick bullets, 'Analyze my workload' CTA
Screen 2: Workload profile selector — latency-sensitive / cost-sensitive / balanced presets
Screen 3: Batching & caching recommendations — suggested batch sizes, expected latency/cost delta chart, toggle to preview KV cache hits
Screen 4: Quantization suggestions — recommended quant profile with quality delta examples and rollback note
Screen 5: Quickstart summary — selected recommendations, one-click apply to a route, link to detailed evals
copy_snippets: Headline: Optimize inference for your workload in three steps.
Bullet: Batching — group concurrent requests to reduce per-token cost with an optional latency window.
Tooltip: KV Cache — cache prefix tokens to skip computation for repeated prompts. Toggle to enable conservative or aggressive caching.
Quant blurb: Use 'int8-balanced' for 2-4x throughput improvements with minimal quality impact on short prompts.
CTA: Apply recommendations to route — updates model configuration and queues a canary rollout.
visual_specs: Layout grid: 12-column, 1200px max width for Console screenshots
Typography: Inter 16/20 for body, 18/24 medium for headings, token labels at 12px semi-bold
Color: use Console palette tokens (primary: #0056FF, success: #07B27A, caution: #FFB020, neutral-800: #222) — provide WCAG AA contrast
Iconography: concise glyph set (batch, cache, quant) — 24px, line-weight 2px
Animation: micro-interaction GIFs at 60fps, loop 3s, max 800kb (prefer WEBM for docs)
accessibility_notes: All hero and screenshot images must include descriptive alt text — provide alt text drafts in the asset package
Ensure color contrast for status badges meets WCAG AA (contrast ratio >= 4.5:1 for body text)
Provide text transcripts for GIFs showing state changes (before/after batch size, cache hits shown)
Keyboard focus states for batch slider and quant toggle demonstrated in design spec
Screen reader labels for preset profiles: 'Latency-sensitive preset — prefers 99th percentile latency under 150ms'
